description: The dividends recorded on Assets: this tax year so far, and how much of that is in general investment accounts against the dividend allowance; the last 12 months by holding; an estimate for the next 12 months; and the most recent payments. Use for 'how much have I had in dividends', 'which holding pays the most', 'what income do my investments pay'.
